content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends considering screening for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes in children and adolescents who are either overweight or obese. Overweight is defined as having a body mass index (BMI) at or above the 85th percentile for age and sex. Screening should be initiated in these individuals if they also have additional risk factors for diabetes. This screening is advised to begin at the onset of puberty or at the age of 10 years, whichever occurs earlier.
